p.n: 빨갛다 is brighter and plainer; 붉다 is deeper and more poetic.

examples.en: I bought three red tomatoes.
I sliced a tomato and added it to the salad.
This tomato is very sweet.
I made pasta with tomato sauce.
Please put tomato in the sandwich.

explain: 작은 토마토는 “방울토마토”라고 해요. 방울은 작고 둥근 물방울을 뜻해요.
explain_en: A small tomato is called 방울토마토 (cherry tomato). 방울 means a small round drop.

I boiled some potatoes and dipped them in salt.
I put potatoes in the soybean paste stew.

explain_en: 감자 (potato) and 고구마 (sweet potato) are different. 감자 often goes into stews and side dishes; 고구마 is sweet and often eaten as a snack.

I put cucumber in my gimbap.
There are two cucumbers in the fridge.
I cut a cucumber and dip it in gochujang.
Cucumbers are juicy and refreshing.

explain: 여름에는 시원한 오이냉국을 많이 먹어요. 오이를 얇게 썰어 차가운 국물에 넣은 음식이에요.
explain_en: In summer many people eat cold 오이냉국, a dish of thinly sliced cucumber in cold broth.
